title: Run a progressive human interview and summarize the answers

goal.value: Run a progressive human interview and summarize the answers

dockerfile.value:
# Lab runner image, built on demand by fabro (image.dockerfile).
#
# Content-hash tagged by fabro (fabro-runner-<sha12>) and rebuilt only
# when this file changes; docker layer cache keeps incremental rebuilds
# cheap. The build context is EMPTY (fabro limitation): .mise.toml cannot
# be COPY'd, so the toolset below mirrors [tools] in .mise.toml — keep
# both in sync (bun/nushell/go/just/ripgrep versions MUST match). ripgrep
# rides the mise aqua backend (NOT apt): one tool source, same pin in both
# files, agent search tools resolve through the shims like every other
# tool (run 01M0SS23MJ planner burned 4-5 calls on a missing rg).
#
# Restores what fabro-meta-a7c3 asked for: tools baked in, per-run
# `mise install` becomes a no-op version check instead of ~24.5s setup.
FROM ubuntu:24.04

ARG MISE_VERSION=v2026.8.10

ENV MISE_DATA_DIR=/mise \
    BUN_INSTALL=/mise/bun-global \
    PATH=/usr/local/bin:/mise/shims:/mise/bun-global/bin:/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin

# Sandbox requirements (bash, git) + mise itself.
RUN set -eux; \
    apt-get update; \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends bash git ca-certificates curl xz-utils; \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*; \
    curl -fsSL "https://github.com/jdx/mise/releases/download/${MISE_VERSION}/mise-${MISE_VERSION}-linux-x64" \
        -o /usr/local/bin/mise; \
    chmod +x /usr/local/bin/mise; \
    mise --version

# Workspace toolset, mirroring .mise.toml [tools] (see header note).
# `mise use -g` sets global defaults (needed: shims resolve versions from
# config; the empty context has no .mise.toml to copy) and installs. The
# workspace .mise.toml pins the same versions for runs, so per-run
# `mise install` stays a no-op check.
RUN mise use -g \
        bun@1.4.0 \
        aqua:nushell/nushell@0.115.0 \
        go@1.27.0 \
        just@1.58.0 \
        aqua:BurntSushi/ripgrep@15.2.0 \
    && bun --version \
    && nu --version \
    && go version \
    && just --version \
    && rg --version

# npm-distributed CLIs into the pinned BUN_INSTALL dir (see
# scripts/bootstrap.nu): sd + ml available without per-run install.
RUN mise exec -- bun install -g \
        @os-eco/seeds-cli@0.5.15 \
        @os-eco/mulch-cli@0.10.7 \
    && sd --version \
    && ml --version

spec.graph_source:
digraph Interview {
    graph [goal="Run a progressive human interview and summarize the answers"]
    rankdir=LR

    start [shape=Mdiamond, label="Start"]
    exit  [shape=Msquare, label="Exit"]

    yes_no [
        shape=hexagon,
        label="Is this interview workflow easy to follow so far?",
        question_type="yes_no"
    ]
    confirmation [
        shape=hexagon,
        label="Confirm that you want to continue into more structured questions.",
        question_type="confirmation"
    ]
    multiple_choice [
        shape=hexagon,
        label="Which theme should be the center of the final summary?",
        question_type="multiple_choice"
    ]
    multi_select [
        shape=hexagon,
        label="Which supporting areas should the final summary emphasize?",
        question_type="multi_select"
    ]
    freeform [
        shape=hexagon,
        label="Add any final context, constraints, or nuance for the summary.",
        question_type="freeform"
    ]
    summarize [
        shape=tab,
        label="Summarize Interview",
        fidelity="summary:high",
        prompt="Summarize the full human interview. Include each question and answer in order, then synthesize the user's priorities, constraints, and open questions. Use the human.gate.<node>.question and human.gate.<node>.answer context keys when present. Do not invent missing answers."
    ]

    start -> yes_no

    yes_no -> confirmation [label="[Y] Yes"]
    yes_no -> confirmation [label="[N] No"]

    confirmation -> multiple_choice [label="[Y] Continue"]
    confirmation -> multiple_choice [label="[N] Stop after this, but still summarize"]

    multiple_choice -> multi_select [label="[G] Goals"]
    multiple_choice -> multi_select [label="[R] Risks"]
    multiple_choice -> multi_select [label="[T] Tradeoffs"]
    multiple_choice -> multi_select [label="[Q] Open questions"]

    multi_select -> freeform [label="[S] Success criteria"]
    multi_select -> freeform [label="[B] Blockers"]
    multi_select -> freeform [label="[D] Decisions needed"]
    multi_select -> freeform [label="[N] Next steps"]

    freeform -> summarize [freeform=true]
    summarize -> exit
}
